<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="LED circuit" id="circuit_led"> <mxGraphModel dx="1188" dy="815" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="880" pageHeight="560" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;" value="<b>LED circuit</b> — the blinking light (GPIO 12)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="520" x="180" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="esp" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#30363d;strokeColor=#111;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=16;" value="

ESP32
(the "brain")" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="190" width="150" x="60" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pinGPIO" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffd966;strokeColor=#bf9000;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="GPIO 12" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="60" x="186" y="165" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pinGND" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#cccccc;strokeColor=#666;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" value="GND" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="60" x="186" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w1" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeWidth=3;strokeColor=#444;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="246" y="178" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="300" y="178" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rzig" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeWidth=3;strokeColor=#444;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="312" y="178" /> <mxPoint x="322" y="163" /> <mxPoint x="340" y="193" /> <mxPoint x="358" y="163" /> <mxPoint x="376" y="193" /> <mxPoint x="394" y="163" /> <mxPoint x="408" y="193" /> <mxPoint x="416" y="178" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="300" y="178" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="178" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rlabel" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#7f6000;" value="resistor
220 Ω" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="90" x="318" y="118" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w2" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeWidth=3;strokeColor=#444;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="420" y="178" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="470" y="178" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ledtri" parent="1" style="triangle;html=1;direction=east;fillColor=#ff5b5b;strokeColor=#a80000;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="36" x="470" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ledbar" parent="1" style="rounded=0;fillColor=#a80000;strokeColor=#a80000;html=1;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="5" x="506" y="154" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lightA" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=classicThin;html=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#f6ae2d;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="492" y="158" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="516" y="132" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lightB" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=classicThin;html=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#f6ae2d;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="504" y="160" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="530" y="138" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ledlabel" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#a80000;" value="LED
(+ leg = long, on the flat/triangle side)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="160" x="428" y="206" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w3" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;html=1;strokeWidth=3;strokeColor=#444;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="660" y="178" /> <mxPoint x="660" y="298" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="511" y="178" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="246" y="298" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="curr" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=block;html=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#e07000;fontColor=#e07000;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;dashed=0;" value="current flows only when GPIO 12 is HIGH (3.3 V)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="300" y="90" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="470" y="90" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="phys" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eef6ff;strokeColor=#4a90d9;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;" value="⚡ <b>Physics:</b> the pin is a tiny switch. HIGH puts 3.3 V across the loop, so current flows GPIO 12 → resistor → LED → GND and the LED glows. An LED is a <i>diode</i>: current one way only, and it drops ~2 V. Without the 220 Ω resistor the current would spike and burn it out — the resistor limits current to a safe ~6 mA (Ohm's law: I = V ÷ R). "Blinking" is just the code flipping the pin HIGH/LOW fast." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="760" x="60" y="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: ⚡ Physics: the pin is a tiny switch. HIGH puts 3.3 V across the loop, so current flows GPIO 12 → resistor → LED → GND and the LED glows. An LED is a diode: current one way only, and it drops ~2 V. Without the 220 Ω resistor the current would spike and burn it out — the resistor limits current to a safe ~6 mA (Ohm's law: I = V ÷ R). "Blinking" is just the code flipping the pin HIGH/LOW fast.
